name: mamba_combat_pair
description: Two male black mambas in ritual combat: lower bodies wound round each other in a rope-like 2.5-turn twist rising from the ground, tails trailing out left and right along the ground, raised necks pressed together and leaning inward, one head bearing down over the other's neck while the other shoves up across its throat, heads at about local y -380, mouths closed, rigid. Olive-grey library palette; the second male is a touch darker so the twist reads. Anchor bottom-centre; bbox about x -255..+255, y -410..0.
